Author: Krishan Pahal
Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 79
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 3120 of 2023
Applicant :- Saddam Hussain

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Udai Prakash Deo Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
List has been revised.

Heard Sri Udai Prakash Deo Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri V.K.S. Parmar,
learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.180 of 2022, registered under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 IPC at Police Station- Chopan, District Sonbhadra with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused person Pradeep Kumar has already been granted anticipatory bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 10.01.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No.8162 of 2022.

Therefore,
the present applicant is also entitled for anticipatory bail on the ground of parity.

Learned counsel Saddam Hussain vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105491768/
1 for the applicant undertakes that he will cooperate in the trial failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of the anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Saddam Hussain vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The prayer for anticipatory bail has been vehemently opposed by learned A.G.A.
However, the aforesaid factual aspect of the parity to the co-accused has not been disputed by him.

On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the fact that the co-accused person has already been enlarged on anticipatory bail, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicants shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.
